_comment: Static pointer chains to the game's current-map-area record. The record holds int32 LocalArea at +0 and int32 UIArea at uiAreaRel. LocalArea is unique per (area, floor); -1 = overworld. The record is one slot in a ~43k-slot array, so a drifted chain can resolve to a stale slot -- localAreaReader resolves BOTH chains, prefers the value they agree on, and verifies (uiArea,localArea) is a real pair in config/localAreas.json. If one chain drifts it fails that check and the other still stands. Both chains verified live resolving to the same record (426 = Forgotten Tunnel 1F). See .map/README.md.
